articleHero.headline: How Often Should You Get a Massage?
articleHero.directAnswer: For general relaxation and wellbeing, many people enjoy a massage every four to six weeks. If you are managing specific tension or training hard, a session every one to two weeks for a while can help — then settle into a maintenance rhythm.

richText.body:
## For general wellness
A monthly massage is a comfortable rhythm for most people to stay relaxed and loosen everyday tension.

## For specific tension or training
During a busy or active stretch, weekly or biweekly sessions can help you stay ahead of tightness, then ease back to monthly.

## Finding your rhythm
There is no one-size-fits-all answer. Notice how you feel between visits — our membership makes a regular monthly massage easy and affordable.
